name: last-mile
description: Kills the last 20% of an almost-finished project. Scans the repo for unfinished edges: TODO/FIXME/HACK markers, missing UI states (empty/loading/error/404), production basics (favicon, meta/OG tags, robots.txt, error boundaries), unhandled promises and exceptions, console.log debris, and placeholder text. Emits a prioritized punch list; then the agent fixes items in order, one commit each.
